data.name: TipRadioSanitizedBackup
data.value: Same file scope as a normal backup, but every *.json value whose key matches the sensitive-keys classifier (env, headers, credentials, auth, *token, *secret, *password, *apikey, bearer) is replaced with the literal string "[redacted]". Intended for sharing your configuration shape with support, the community, or a bug report without leaking API keys, MCP auth headers, or OAuth tokens. opencode.db is excluded outright — its secrets are SQLite rows, which the redactor cannot reach. Sanitized archives cannot be restored.
